claimBoundary: The flow is contextual guidance over existing runtime state. It does not determine legal applicability, notification duties, certification, or organizational adequacy.

stages.purpose: Registrare decisione, motivazione, responsabilità e azione.

definitionOfDone: The six-stage flow is rendered as guidance and never as an automatic legal conclusion.
Only one recommended stage is prominent on each operational surface.
The complete six-stage path is available through progressive disclosure.
Settings show exactly three configuration steps and at most one open step.
Context and connection are presented before optional assisted instructions.
Required settings fields are visually distinguished without relying on colour alone.
Long prompt fields are collapsed behind the optional third step.
Governance configuration separates service context from limits and models.
Local identity creation is collapsed by default.
Monitoring configuration is split into objective, criteria, and scheduling groups with one group open at a time.
Existing form names, API endpoints and submit handlers are preserved.
The terminal module performs no fetch and grants no capability.
The settings dialog reflows without horizontal overflow at 320 and 390 CSS pixels.
The interface remains usable at 200 percent zoom.
Focus order follows visual order after DOM regrouping.
Every disclosure has a programmatic summary and visible focus.
Reduced-motion and forced-colour preferences are respected.
Primary labels avoid unscoped certification, verification and readiness claims.
The browser fixture covers admin, user and auditor projections.
Saturation reaches M and the following 100 scenarios add no novelty.
No new contradiction is detected in the M+100 confirmation tail.
The PR remains draft until the server-backed CI journey passes on the same head.
